clinical.title: Academic Validation & Clinical Trial Data
clinical.card1_desc: Parvogel's core ultra-fine process technology proves overwhelming performance compared to conventional anti-diarrheal raw materials.
clinical.techSummaryBody: Compared to general montmorillonite, it maximizes the physical adsorption and removal of intestinal toxins and harmful viruses through a surface area more than 8 times larger (≥800 m²/g) and particles more than 50 times finer (≤6.5 µm).
clinical.paperRef1: Smectite & Montmorillonite global research references on toxin adsorption & anti-diarrhea
clinical.card2_desc: Test results based on the academic evidence of Prof. Lee Hu-jang's research team at Gyeongsang National University College of Veterinary Medicine.
clinical.table2_row3_cond: Clinical experience with approx. 6,000 parvo enteritis cases
clinical.card3_desc: Virus-family-specific inhibitory effects of DNJ produced by Bacillus subtilis MORI, the core strain of DNG-1000.
clinical.antiviralSummaryBody: DNJ produced by the core strain (Bacillus subtilis MORI) of DNG-1000 has been proven to significantly suppress the proliferation of 5 major virus families in cattle, pigs, and poultry.
clinical.card4_desc: Parvogel is currently being validated through review meetings with veterinary experts.
clinical.card4_quote1: "1-Deoxynojirimycin (DNJ)'s multi-virus inhibitory effects and differentiated adsorption of harmful substances are a clear point of differentiation."
clinical.card4_quote1_author: Prof. Bong-gyun Park (Former Head of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency; authority in virology)
clinical.card4_quote2: "Particle size, moisture absorption rate, specific surface area... It has all the data veterinarians want."
clinical.card4_quote3: "Beyond simple diarrhea treatment, its overwhelming palatability—well accepted even by patients with vomiting and abdominal pain—and instant pain relief make it essential as a first-line stock and supplementary aid for the full range of digestive issues."
clinical.card4_quote4: "It might be good for humans too..."
clinical.card4_quote4_author: Prof. Hwa-young Yoon (Former Professor of Internal Medicine, Seoul National University College of Veterinary Medicine · Former Head of Internal Medicine, Seoul National University Veterinary Hospital)
clinical.card4_note: Parvogel's academic and advisory panel is composed of veterinary experts, including former faculty of Seoul National University College of Veterinary Medicine, who rigorously validate the clinical data and administration standards.
clinical.researchBasis: Based on academic research data from Prof. Hoo-jang Lee's team, College of Veterinary Medicine, Gyeongsang National University
clinical.virusDescArteri: Demonstrated inhibition of arterivirus replication by the DNJ component produced by the DNG-1000 core strain (Bacillus subtilis MORI)
clinical.virusDescOrtho: Confirmed inhibition of envelope protein synthesis and suppression of proliferation of Orthomyxoviridae influenza viruses
clinical.virusDescPesti: Demonstrated inhibition of enteric pestivirus replication and supportive mitigation of intestinal mucosal damage
clinical.virusDescBunya: Confirmed antiviral activity and proliferation inhibition against Bunyaviridae Akabane and Aino viruses
clinical.virusDescRhabdo: Verified significant proliferation-inhibiting effect against the Rhabdoviridae bovine ephemeral fever virus
